specialties.name: War Priest
specialties.intent: You are the only priest who stands in the front rank: your damage is small, but it is true, and nothing the enemy wears makes it smaller.

triggers.effect: your melee attacks deal +2 true damage against undead or demon

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Priest/War Priest (melee 2 / ranged 1 / armor 1 rebuilt to Strength and Armor; Hold the Line's name went to Warrior/Guardian, so its mechanic is re-authored as Shield of Faith) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: dodge -5. Parked abilities: onKill: heal yourself 2 and every ally adjacent to you 1. | 2026-08-17 off-primary pass: the Wayfinder case exactly — a melee Priest needs +2 Strength to be one.

specialties.name: Shepherd
specialties.intent: You keep the flock standing — small, constant, cheap healing, and you strip the Burn first because Burn is what makes healing worthless.
specialties.source: Hell-TCG Priest/Oracle, RENAMED — Oracle collided with Prophet/Oracle and the Prophet has the stronger claim. The draw engine (Prophecy of Light) moved to the Prophet; the healing kit (Circle of Healing, Close Wounds) stayed here under a new name. | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: strength -1. Parked abilities: onActivationEnd: the ally within 3 hexes with the lowest current Health heals 1. | 2026-08-17: CUT. ally-reactive hooks, guarding, Consequence-Stack interference and non-knockback forced movement all removed by ruling.

specialties.name: Divine Light
specialties.intent: You are a fixed point on the map that the party fights around: slow, bright, and everything standing in your light is harder to kill.

triggers.effect: AURA radius 2 — at the end of your Activation every ally inside gains Protection 2, which decays 1 a Phase and by whatever it absorbs, so the light is worth standing in again next Turn.

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Priest/Divine Light (Divine Leadership cut — it granted Actions; Sanctuary renamed to Hallowed Ground, Sanctuary is taken by Ranger) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: movement -1. Parked abilities: onAllyDamaged: once per Turn, if an ally within 2 hexes is reduced below half Health, it gains 2 Protection. | 2026-08-17 quality pass: replaced a placeholder aura with a distinct effect.

specialties.name: Redeemer
specialties.intent: You burn on purpose. The fire is your weapon and your penance — and it means nobody can heal you properly for the rest of the fight.

triggers.effect: you gain 3 Burn, and gain +1 Strength for the rest of the Battle for as long as you are carrying any Burn

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Martyr/Redeemer (self-Burn kept and made the identity, now that Burn halves healing on its holder) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: armor -1. Parked abilities: onTakingDamage: if the attacker is adjacent to you, it gains 1 Burn.

specialties.name: Blessed Sufferer
specialties.intent: You have more room to be hurt than anyone, and you spend it on other people: the party's damage arrives at your Health bar instead of theirs.

triggers.effect: the wound is taken as a gift: gain Protection 1.

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Martyr/Blessed Sufferer (dodge 3 rebuilt as +5 Dodge; maxAfflictions is Toughness now and this is where it belongs) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: strength -1; itemSlots -1. Parked abilities: onDowned: when you fail Deathbed Fighting, every ally within 3 hexes heals 3. | 2026-08-17: CUT. ally-reactive hooks, guarding, Consequence-Stack interference and non-knockback forced movement all removed by ruling. | 2026-08-17 quality pass: replaced a placeholder aura with a distinct effect. | 2026-08-20: there is no stacking-limit feature, so the cap is cut. Now unbounded: Protection decays 1 a Phase and is spent by what it absorbs, so it limits itself.

specialties.name: Martyred Saint
specialties.intent: Going down is your best turn. You are dangerous standing, worse bleeding out, and worst of all at zero.

triggers.effect: every enemy within 3 hexes takes 6 true damage and gains 3 Burn; every ally within 3 hexes heals 4

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Martyr/Martyred Saint (onDeath detonation kept, extended down the Consequence Stack to the bleed-out state) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: dodge -5. Parked abilities: onDowned: while you are downed and bleeding out, every enemy adjacent to you takes 2 true damage at the end of each Turn.

specialties.name: Oracle
specialties.intent: You see the field before it happens: thin, slow to hurt anything, and the reason everyone else's numbers are better than they should be.

triggers.effect: you and every ally within 3 hexes gain +5 Accuracy for the rest of the Battle

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Prophet/Oracle — WINNER of the Oracle collision. The card-draw payload is gone; 'omniscient but fragile' is rebuilt on Vision and Accuracy, which HoBaT has and Hell-TCG did not. | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: health -2; vision +3. Parked abilities: onActivationEnd: name one enemy within your Vision; it has -5 Dodge against your party until the end of the next Turn. | 2026-08-17: third stat luck +5 — you see it coming, which is the same thing as being hard to crit.

specialties.name: Seer
specialties.intent: You do not make the party stronger, you make the enemy thinner: armour, resist and luck all come off the thing you are looking at.

triggers.effect: the target loses 1 Luck against your party for the rest of the Battle

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Prophet/Seer ('foresees enemy weakness and exploits it' — rebuilt as Luck, Armor and Resist stripping; Study Weakness name harvested from the badge pool) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: health -1; vision +1. Parked abilities: onAllyDamaged: once per Turn, when an ally within 4 hexes is hit, that ally gains +5 Dodge against that attacker for the rest of the Battle. | 2026-08-20: there is no stacking-limit feature, so the cap is cut. Now unbounded: onHit against one target — the least self-limiting of the seven, and the one worth a second look.

specialties.name: Diviner
specialties.intent: You buy the party tempo — a hex here, a Stamina there — and the single most useful thing you do all fight might happen while you are bleeding out.

triggers.effect: on Turn 1 only, you and every ally within 3 hexes gain +1 Movement and 1 Stamina

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Prophet/Diviner (the entry burst of Actions and the death-draw are rebuilt as Movement and Stamina tempo — Actions and draws are cut in HoBaT) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: armor -1; health +1. Parked abilities: onDeath: every ally within 4 hexes gains +10 Accuracy and +1 Movement for the rest of the Battle.

powers.name: Restoration
